title: TreeSpark: Learning to Draft the Trees You Verify for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.20175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark reduce proposal latency, but early mismatches limit how much of each block can be accepted. Retaining alternatives introduces parent states and candidate choices that reference-conditioned training does not directly supervise. We introduce TreeSpark, a unified training and inference framework extending the semi-autoregressive DSpark architecture. It constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from one backbone pass and replays their expansion, pruning, and budgeted packing during training. Survival negative log-likelihood weights retained edges by reference-derived path mass, while a capped coverage hinge promotes target-important alternatives near local selection boundaries. Both objectives reuse reference-chain target distributions without additional target forward passes. We evaluate greedy decoding with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B on nine general benchmarks and six writing domains. Across targe

translated_title: TreeSpark：为推测解码学习草拟你所验证的树
translated_abstract: 诸如 DFlash 和 DSpark 等并行起草器能够降低提案延迟，但早期的失配限制了每个文本块中可被接受的部分。保留备选方案会引入父状态和候选选择，而基于参考的条件训练并不能直接监督这些内容。我们提出 TreeSpark，这是一个扩展半自回归 DSpark 架构的统一训练与推理框架。它通过一次骨干网络前向传播构建以父节点为条件的候选树，并在训练期间重放其扩展、剪枝和预算约束下的打包过程。生存负对数似然根据源自参考模型的路径质量为保留的边加权，同时一个设有上限的覆盖铰链损失则促进局部选择边界附近对目标模型重要的备选方案。这两个目标函数均复用参考链的目标分布，无需额外的目标模型前向传播。我们在九个通用基准和六个写作领域上，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 以贪心解码方式进行评估。
tldr: TreeSpark 提出一个统一的训练与推理框架，通过一次骨干前向传播构建父节点条件的候选树，并利用生存负对数似然和有上限覆盖铰链两种目标函数（复用参考链目标分布、无需额外目标模型前向传播）来训练推测解码的草稿树，从而提升并行草稿的接受率。
en_tdlr: TreeSpark is a unified training and inference framework for speculative decoding that constructs parent-conditioned candidate trees from a single backbone pass and trains them with survival NLL and capped coverage hinge objectives—reusing reference-chain target distributions without extra target forward passes—to improve the acceptance of parallel draft trees.
